latestVersion.changelog:
Agent Builder for OpenClaw: initial release

- Build complete OpenClaw agent workspaces from scratch or iterate on existing ones.
- Structured workflow: clarifying interview, automated file generation, guardrails checklist, and fast acceptance tests.
- Supports advanced customization: autonomy level, memory options, tone, and tool posture.
- Generates all required files (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md) plus optionals (MEMORY.md, TOOLS.md).
- Guidance for safety rules, group behavior, and scenario-based validation.
